_readme: S690 catalogs worker, 2026-11-20, under the conductor's order of 2026-11-20 (#3584, comment 7042523337): one plain request per CourseLeaf host before any course page is read. The census Reader asks for robots.txt first with a plain request (no browser) and stops at a WAF's challenge header (x-amzn-waf-action), so a challenged host is named and never loaded; the only page this plan names is robots.txt itself. No retry, no model call.

questions.plain_request: Whether the host answers a plain request with 200 and content, or with 202 and a WAF check.
